, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that The Newest Pledge has the director born earlier, despite correctly finding that Jason Michael Brescia (1986) directed The Newest Pledge and Oscar Barney Finn (1938) directed Más allá de la aventura. This is a logical reversal/mix-up in the final comparison; the earlier-born director is Finn, so the correct film is Más allá de la aventura.
